claims.sentence: Applicants, teachers, staff, and the public should review the qualification requirements for each academic position below
To apply for a professor position, you must hold a Doctor of Sciences degree and at least 5 years of scientific-pedagogical experience, or hold a professor academic title

To apply for an associate professor position, you must have higher professional education, a Candidate or Doctor of Sciences degree, and at least 3 years of scientific-pedagogical experience, or hold a docent or senior researcher academic title

To apply for a senior lecturer position, you must have higher professional education and at least 3 years of scientific-pedagogical experience, or at least 1 year of experience if you hold a Candidate of Sciences degree

To apply for a lecturer position, you must have higher professional education and at least 1 year of work experience in an educational institution, or no experience requirement if you have postgraduate education or a Candidate of Sciences degree

To apply for an assistant position, you must have higher professional education and at least 1 year of work experience in an educational institution, or no experience requirement if you have postgraduate education or a Candidate of Sciences degree
For senior lecturer, lecturer, and assistant positions, candidates with a Candidate of Sciences degree receive priority in the competitive selection
Qualifications and education obtained in a foreign state are considered if they are recognized in the Russian Federation according to international treaties or Russian legislation
If you are a foreign citizen who passes the competition, the Department of Attraction and Support of Teaching Staff prepares and sends you a job offer

If you accept the job offer, the Department handles the administrative support for your invitation and admission, which includes preparing a visa invitation and a work permit, including for highly qualified specialists
A passport
A diploma, including foreign diplomas that are legalized and recognized in the Russian Federation
A diploma supplement, if available, including foreign supplements that are legalized and recognized in the Russian Federation
A document confirming a scientific degree or academic title, including foreign documents that are legalized and recognized in the Russian Federation
Documents confirming your pedagogical, scientific, or scientific-pedagogical experience
A certificate of criminal record or absence thereof, or a certificate of termination of criminal prosecution on rehabilitating grounds, legalized for the Russian Federation
A marriage certificate, legalized for the Russian Federation
Birth certificates for children under 18, if applicable, legalized for the Russian Federation
Notarized Russian translations of all documents if they are in a foreign language, prepared according to Russian legislation
A medical book and conclusions from medical and psychiatric examinations conducted based on directions issued by the Department
The evidence does not specify the exact deadlines for submitting documents or for the Department to process visa invitations and work permits
The evidence does not list the specific international treaties or Russian legislative acts that govern the recognition of foreign qualifications
The evidence does not detail the exact procedures for the medical and psychiatric examinations beyond stating they require directions from the Department
The evidence cuts off after mentioning the medical book and examination conclusions, so it does not state what additional requirements or steps follow
The evidence does not specify whether non-academic staff or administrative positions have different eligibility criteria
The evidence does not clarify how the priority for candidates with a Candidate of Sciences degree is applied in practice or what happens if multiple candidates hold the degree
